text:
lucy (release): FYI starting handoff for vpc-offline-installer-2.0.0-rc1. pushing artifacts to staging registry now. planned canary at 21:10 UTC, serial across 2 clusters.

harry (infra): ack. images pushed to staging-reg with tag vpc-offline-installer-2.0.0-rc1. manifest sha256: b8c9d1a...4e7

pete (ops): enqueueing cosign signing job. signer: signer-kms-01. prefer 20m hold after sign for smoke checks. anyone object? :thinking_face:

sam (sre): no objections. set rollback triggers: any node crashloop >1 within 10m OR request error rate >1% during canary. also watch cold-start p50 >8s.

lucy (release): agreed. I'll update release checklist and include a short note: "rc1 includes offline bundle checksum delta and connector memory tweak"

deploy-bot: cosign: signature created for vpc-offline-installer-2.0.0-rc1 by signer-kms-01. cosign sig: cosign:sha256:bb44ef...

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 21:10 UTC. target groups: vpc-eu-01 (2 nodes), vpc-us-west-ops (1 node). TTL 25m. strategy: parallel small batches.

harry (infra): quick local check you can run on staging:
```
curl -fsS http://staging-1.internal:8080/ready || echo "not ready"
```

pete (ops): staging-1 returned READY. logs show prefetch mem ~420MB. baseline is ~380MB but within expected margin.

lucy (release): docs: added notes to docs/releases/vpc-offline-installer-2.0.0-rc1.md and linked the perf-run repo for replay. tagging @support for release notes preview.

sam (sre): deploy-bot: start canary now. we will stream events to #release-watching.

deploy-bot: canary started at 21:10 UTC. vpc-eu-01 nodeA ok, nodeB ok. vpc-us-west-ops node1 ok. monitoring enabled.

harry (infra): monitors show initial p95 latency spike to 1.8s (expected). memory trending up slightly on nodeB.

sam (sre): nodeB just hit OOM-kill on the shim process at 21:14 UTC. marking as failed.

deploy-bot: canary check failed: nodeB OOM-kill detected. assessing rollback policy.

pete (ops): initiating immediate manifest unpin and route revert to vpc-offline-installer-1.9.7. starting redeploy on nodeB.

lucy (release): hold on promotions. I'll mark rc1 as "on-hold - investigation" in the release tracker and add quarantine flag.

harry (infra): quick trace shows a threefold increase in prefetch buffers in this build. suspect the new connector prewarm. I'll open a small patch to cap prefetch to baseline.

sam (sre): after revert metrics back to normal. p50 latency back to 0.9s, errors down. good. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollback executed at 21:18 UTC. active tag restored to vpc-offline-installer-1.9.7.

pete (ops): will request cosign revocation for rc1 and remove it from the active index. also archiving the signed manifest to quarantine bucket.

lucy (release): thanks. scheduling a follow-up: perf lab stress test with capped prefetch + memory monitor. aiming to re-run canary next Wed 09:00 UTC if patch validated.

harry (infra): I'll push a patch branch with prefetch cap and a small memory regression test. assigning to infra-ci.

sam (sre): please add a test that simulates cold-start with large offline bundles. that was the trigger last time.

lucy (release): noted. I'll update the release checklist and notify product & support. will attach logs + core dump to the ticket.

deploy-bot: ticket updated: REL-4521. quarantine manifest: gs://quarantine/releases/vpc-offline-installer-2.0.0-rc1/manifest.json

pete (ops): rubber stamp: once infra has patch + perf passes we can schedule a narrow window. ops prefers Tue 07:00-09:00 UTC.

lucy (release): adding that to ticket. thanks everyone.
